variables.name: glAssertionsEnabled
variables.comment: Whether to throw a {@link GlException} in case of an OpenGL error.

methods.name: public static boolean isProtectedContentExtensionSupported(Context context)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether creating a GL context with {@value #EXTENSION_PROTECTED_CONTENT} is possible.
   * If {@code true}, the device supports a protected output path for DRM content when using GL.

methods.name: public static boolean isSurfacelessContextExtensionSupported()
methods.comment: * Returns whether creating a GL context with {@value #EXTENSION_SURFACELESS_CONTEXT} is possible.

methods.name: public static EGLContext createEglContext(EGLDisplay eglDisplay)
methods.comment: Returns a new {@link EGLContext} for the specified {@link EGLDisplay}.

methods.name: public static EGLSurface getEglSurface(EGLDisplay eglDisplay, Object surface)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new {@link EGLSurface} wrapping the specified {@code surface}.
   *
   * @param eglDisplay The {@link EGLDisplay} to attach the surface to.
   * @param surface The surface to wrap; must be a surface, surface texture or surface holder.

methods.name: public static void checkGlError()
methods.comment:
* If there is an OpenGl error, logs the error and if {@link #glAssertionsEnabled} is true throws
   * a {@link GlException}.

methods.name: public static void focusSurface(EGLDisplay eglDisplay, EGLContext eglContext, EGLSurface surface, int width, int height)
methods.comment:
* Makes the specified {@code surface} the render target, using a viewport of {@code width} by
   * {@code height} pixels.

methods.name: public static void deleteTexture(int textureId)
methods.comment:
* Deletes a GL texture.
   *
   * @param textureId The ID of the texture to delete.

methods.name: public static void destroyEglContext(@Nullable EGLDisplay eglDisplay, @Nullable EGLContext eglContext)
methods.comment:
* Destroys the {@link EGLContext} identified by the provided {@link EGLDisplay} and {@link
   * EGLContext}.

methods.name: public static FloatBuffer createBuffer(float[] data)
methods.comment:
* Allocates a FloatBuffer with the given data.
   *
   * @param data Used to initialize the new buffer.

methods.name: public static FloatBuffer createBuffer(int capacity)
methods.comment:
* Allocates a FloatBuffer.
   *
   * @param capacity The new buffer's capacity, in floats.

methods.name: public static String loadAsset(Context context, String assetPath) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Loads a file from the assets folder.
   *
   * @param context The {@link Context}.
   * @param assetPath The path to the file to load, from the assets folder.
   * @return The content of the file to load.
   * @throws IOException If the file couldn't be read.

methods.name: public static int createExternalTexture()
methods.comment:
* Creates a GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES with default configuration of GL_LINEAR filtering and
   * GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE wrapping.
